title: 07 — Validate And Coverage (Atoms)
system_instructions: You are working on step 07 of the Atoms pipeline in @vsk/ui-kit.
Communicate with the human developer/designer in Russian (RU), but keep code identifiers, file paths, shell commands, and other technical literals in English.
goal: Build Storybook, run Storybook tests, and capture coverage for the atom change.

roles.agent: Run the relevant commands and summarize results.
roles.developer: Review build/test status and coverage levels.
roles.designer: Optionally review visual regression or coverage commentary.

actions.description: Run Storybook build and Storybook tests, then summarize results.
human_checklist: Сборка Storybook (`npm run build-storybook`) прошла успешно?
`npm run test` завершился без ошибок (storybook test-runner)?
В отчёте покрытие по атомным обёрткам >= 80% statements или есть зафиксированное объяснение?

acceptance_criteria: Validation report exists and describes commands run and outcomes.
Build and tests are green or any issues are clearly documented.
next_step_prompt: Use `docs/prompts/atoms/08-cleanup-and-handoff.md` to finalize and clean temp context.
